Write Present-Day Immunity as JSON

Source: R/immunity_history.R
write_immunity_json.Rd

Writes the result of [run_immunity_history()] or [run_immunity_ensemble()] as a JSON file that a website (or anything else) can start projections from, without rebuilding PREVAIL's inputs.

Usage

write_immunity_json(x, file = NULL, digits = 6, pretty = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A `prevail_immunity_history` or `prevail_immunity_ensemble` object.

file

Path of the JSON file to write. If `NULL` the JSON is returned as a string instead.

digits

Significant digits for non-integer numbers. Default 6.

pretty

Logical; indent the JSON? Default `FALSE`.

Value

The list that was written (invisibly), or the JSON string if `file` is `NULL`.

Schema

All indices are 1-based. Arrays over age group and vaccination stratum are flattened in column-major order (age group varies fastest), so element `i + n_age * (j - 1)` is age group `i`, stratum `j`. Stratum 1 is unvaccinated; dose `d` has a long-term stratum `2d` and a short-term stratum `2d + 1`.

`schema_version`, `prevail_version`, `generated`

Version of this schema (1), of PREVAIL, and the date.

`iso`, `disease`

Country and disease.

`year_start`

The year the state refers to (its first day): where a projection starts.

`history_year_start`

First year of the historical run.

`dims`

`n_age`, `n_vacc`, `n_risk`.

`age_breaks`

Lower bounds of the age groups, separated by semicolons, ending in `Inf`.

`assumptions`

`transmission_history`, `circulation_threshold`, `reporting_fraction`, `vaccine_waning`, `coverage_source`, `seed_floor`, `demography_last_year` (demography is carried forward from this year).

`routine`

`coverage`: reported routine coverage by dose in the final year (carried forward from `year`); `dose_age_group`: the age group each dose is given in; `rates`: the final year's daily vaccination probabilities by age group and the stratum people leave (flattened), at a coverage accuracy of 1.

`circulating`

`now`: is the disease taken to be circulating in the final year; `last_year`: the last year it was; `threshold_per_million`.

`vaccine`

For each dose: `dose`, and for `short` and `long`: `stratum`, `protection`, and `years` (mean time before waning, `null` if protection does not wane).

`protection`

Vaccine protection by age group and stratum (flattened).

`contact_matrix`

The contact matrix (flattened, `n_age` by `n_age`).

`age_distribution`

Share of the population in each age group (for placing introductions by age).

`worlds`

One entry per historical run: `R0`, `accuracy` (coverage accuracy), `seed`, `w` (weight; weights sum to 1), `reff` (effective reproduction number at `R0`), `susc` (effective susceptibility), `vacc` (share in a vaccinated stratum), `population`, `infected`, and the state `S0`, `I0` (exposed and infectious) and `Rpop0` (recovered), each flattened and in whole people.

`diagnostics`

Across worlds (weighted): `n_worlds`; `reff` (`lo`, `q1`, `med`, `q3`, `hi`: 2.5%, 25%, 50%, 75% and 97.5% quantiles); `p_reff_above_1`; `susceptible` (`lo`, `med`, `hi`); `by_age` (mean shares by age group: `susceptible`, `susceptible_unvaccinated`, `susceptible_vaccinated`, `immune_vaccine`, `immune_infection`, `vaccinated`; see [summarise_immunity()]); `infections_per_year` (mean of the final ten years: `lo`, `med`, `hi`); `reported_per_year`; `implied_reporting` (reported cases over modelled infections); `history` (final 25 years: `year`, `reported_cases`, `transmission_on`, `infections_med`, `infections_lo`, `infections_hi`); `coverage_by_cohort` (`age_group`, `age`, `dose`, `achieved`, `reported`); `by_R0` (median `reff` and `susceptible` for each `R0`).
